title: Solar surpasses nuclear power globally for first time
why_read: An energy-policy milestone with broad relevance but limited direct technical engineering content for a software-focused digest.
analysis: This reports that global solar electricity generation has overtaken nuclear generation, a notable milestone in the energy transition. It's more of a macro energy/policy story than a software engineering one, though it touches on topics like grid integration and energy storage that engineers in climate tech care about. The large comment count hints at a lively debate about methodology, intermittency, and comparisons between energy sources. Useful context for generalist readers, but not core technical content for a software-engineer audience.
